title: Heartbeat Resonance
summary: Introduces a non-contact approach that modulates low-frequency sound to produce heartbeat-like sensations in the chest, evaluated through two experiments.
image_alt: Illustration showing low-frequency sound producing heartbeat sensations in the chest

title: Non-contact Sensations On and In the Body
summary: Uses room-scale low-frequency standing waves to create predictable non-contact sensations at different locations on and within the body.
image_alt: Four-part research diagram showing low-frequency sound forming standing waves around a person

title: HapWheel
summary: Embeds two ubiquitous haptic displays into a steering wheel so drivers can operate in-car controls with short finger movements and receive action-specific feedback.
image_alt: HapWheel prototype and the device mounted on a car steering wheel

title: HapticDrone
summary: Transforms a drone into an encountered-type kinesthetic interface with controlled force for rendering the stiffness and weight of virtual objects.
image_alt: HapticDrone prototype beside a participant interacting with it in virtual reality

title: Haptic Texture Authoring & Prediction
summary: Builds haptic attribute and perceptual spaces, then uses data-driven models to author new textures and predict tactile qualities from image features.
image_alt: A grid of one hundred textured surfaces used to establish a haptic attribute space

title: Perceptually Correct Mid-Air Ultrasound Haptics
summary: Adjusts ultrasound focal-point output across frequencies so mid-air tactile stimuli can be rendered at perceptually aligned magnitudes.
image_alt: A hand positioned over an ultrasound phased array during a haptic perception experiment

title: Multi-Modal Pneumatic Wearable
summary: Combines normal force, lateral cues, and vibration in a compact wearable pneumatic actuator designed for multi-modal haptic feedback.
image_alt: Participant wearing a pneumatic haptic actuator on the forearm during an evaluation
